newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian pastor fights police in gun battle.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian pastor fights police in gun battle.

text.p: A Nigerian preacher was shot and wounded after opening fire with a double-barrelled shotgun on police he thought were armed robbers, the police said on Friday.
They said that Bishop Godwin Elombor, founder of the New Generation Church, was taken to a Lagos hospital when police discovered they had shot a preacher and not an armed robber.
Armed robbery is commonplace in Lagos and other urban centres of impoverished Nigeria.
Police are making enquiries into how Elombor had the gun in his possession.
